text: Nice yeah if u turn it to object mode is auto rotate for the whole piece that would be slick. also, if u can fix the ctrl + a focus, it hits all the text on the app also not just the studio
resolution: Object-mode whole-piece transform + Ctrl+A scope fix (req_1058). (1) Object mode now drives the WHOLE part: the gizmo targets every vert in object mode (anchored at the part center), so move/resize/rotate reorient the whole piece with no select-all; the move/resize/rotate toggle now shows in object mode, and entering object mode arms the rotate tool (the common reorient need). gizmoSelVerts resolves to all verts in object mode, [] in rig, the selection in element modes; the onDown gizmo-grab branch and the toolbar gate were updated to match. This is hot-reload TSX, live now. (2) Ctrl+A scope: the host's Ctrl+A also set selection.zig sel_all, which selects ALL text across the whole app tree, so the Studio's select-all-faces was flashing every label in the app. Added a __selection_clear host door in v8_bindings_core.zig (calls selection.clear()) and the Studio's Ctrl+A handler now calls it via callHost right after taking the key, so the app-wide highlight never renders. The TSX call is a safe no-op on an un-rebuilt host. IMPORTANT: this door is a framework (Zig) change, so it needs a HOST REBUILD to take effect — the object-mode rotate works on hot reload, but the Ctrl+A highlight fix activates after the next rebuild. Studio + full workbench source chain bundle clean; the binding passes zig ast-check. PLAYBOOK Part 6 + memory updated.
